title: Bank Account for Student Society
scenario: A society treasurer asks you to receive funds temporarily because their account is frozen.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.
answers.D: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.

explanation: Bank Account for Student Society: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Do not move money for clubs or friends through personal accounts.
